items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: I saw him on a gig last week... David Black, David on sax... Of course, we always killed him.

ctx.x: I saw him on a gig last week. Last week? David Laskin was really fun.

St. Augustine Hall with Marcel Richardson. Oh, yeah? Oh, yeah? David Black, David on sax. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. And they killed him. They killed him. Wait, did he do his Ray Charles? Yeah, he did some couple of Ray Charles.

Of course, we always killed him. He's the last man I know other than Snook Elgin, but he was always better than Snook Elgin. To do that Ray Charles, the old Ray Charles, the old Ray Charles, the old Ray Charles, the old Ray Charles, the old Ray Charles, the old Ray Charles, the old Ray Charles, the old Ray Charles. And that's so cool.
